description: The CURBy (CU Randomness Beacon, University of Colorado Boulder) adapter for NCode.Randomness: fetches pulses of the CURBy-RNG Twine chain and verifies their content identifiers, RS256 signatures and precommitments against a pinned chain before any byte is used.
